title: Forevercraft: Advantage Trees
description: 13 skill trees, 25 levels each, 3 prestige cycles, 67 prestige abilities.
body:
# Forevercraft: Advantage Trees

*Part of [Forevercraft](https://modrinth.com/datapack/forevercraft-datapack)*

13 trees: Agility, Beastmaster, Blacksmith, Culinary, Dexterity, Evasion, Explorer, Fishing, Gathering, Mining, Stealth, Taskmaster, Victorian. 67 prestige abilities. Cross-tree synergies. Seed of Forgetting respec.

Drop ZIP into datapacks folder and /reload.

[forevercraft.co](https://forevercraft.co) | [Support](https://buymeacoffee.com/forevercraft)
